subtitle: Yoga & rest, fully offline
promotional_text: Personalized yoga, breath, and sleep on this phone, plus a private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud.
description: Brume Lamp is a personal wellness learning system that teaches yoga, breathing, mindfulness, meditation, relaxation, flexibility, and steady daily routines - privately, on your device. After you install the app, it keeps working with Airplane Mode on. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. It is not just a meditation timer. You get a lamp of practice you can dim without a subscription or a signal: personalized sessions, breathing, sleep, and a private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud. Lamp is an on-device teacher that picks a session from your aim, minutes, body feel, hour, and recent practice. Timed yoga and mobility sequences come with teaching cues. Fog glass breathing uses a filling bar. Night practices are written for bed. Pose chimney offers short lessons. Pages is a private journal — fully offline. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Sessions ship inside the app. Journal, preferences, and logs live in local storage.
app_review_notes: Brume Lamp is a complete offline yoga and meditation teacher. Complete onboarding, light Lamp’s session, run Fog glass (filling bar), open Lessons, and save a Pages note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Private journal — fully offline. No account. No cloud.
